# Koombo

Koombo is a community marketplace for discovering authentic products, connecting with trusted sellers, and growing local businesses through direct commerce.

## Official site
- https://www.koombo.app/
- https://www.koombo.app/about
- https://www.koombo.app/shop
- https://www.koombo.app/contact
- https://www.koombo.app/watch-demo
- https://www.koombo.app/seller
- https://www.koombo.app/lister
- https://www.koombo.app/privacy-policy
- https://www.koombo.app/cookie-policy
- https://www.koombo.app/terms

## What Koombo offers
- Product discovery for buyers seeking trustworthy local and community-led shopping.
- Easy seller onboarding to list products and reach customers faster.
- Direct conversation channels between buyers and sellers to build familiarity and trust.
- Business growth tools for creators, marketplaces, and local commerce partners.

## Brand summary
Koombo helps people discover, connect, and transact with confidence. The platform blends product discovery, direct communication, and seller growth tools into a simpler local marketplace experience.
